summary: Frontend regression + Clearbit removal validation. Playwright with network listener navigated /empresas and /empresas/microsoft: 0 requests to clearbit.com (before fix: 41 + 11). All tags render successfully (25/25 on /empresas, 10/10 on /empresas/microsoft, 0 broken). All 18 SPA routes return HTTP 200. Backend /api/companies confirmed returning logo_url pointing to google.com/s2/favicons?domain=&sz=128. Fix validated end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: Google favicons (sz=128) is 128x128 which is acceptable for grid cards; if higher fidelity is desired later, consider a self-hosted logo CDN or Duck Duck Go icons fallback.
LogoImage component with onError fallback to initials is a robust pattern — recommend reusing across all avatar/logo consumers site-wide.
test_credentials: member.demo@puntocero.test-e2e.com / MemberDemo2026 (login not required for /empresas which is public)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Clearbit dependency fully removed. Backend seeder rewrites logo_url on startup to google favicons. Frontend LogoImage + native onError handlers provide initials fallback. Route status: /, /join, /reset-password, /noticias, /videos, /empleos, /empresas, /eventos, /ia, /comunidad, /perfil, /perfil/personalizar, /notificaciones, /mensajes, /nuestra-historia, /legal/*, /mi-espacio, /admin/login all return 200. The 156 net::ERR_ABORTED on /api/* endpoints observed during test are normal — they occur because .goto() to next route aborts in-flight requests from the previous page, not real failures.
rca of the issue: Clearbit discontinued its public logo API in 2025 → logo.clearbit.com DNS no longer resolves → 41+11 broken requests per page → user perceived 'connection problems / links not opening' though all SPA routes always returned 200. Fix: (1) seeder._logo_from_website now emits google.com/s2/favicons URLs, (2) frontend LogoImage + onError handlers gracefully fallback to initials div. Validated: 0 clearbit requests, 0 broken images post-fix.
